rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Kantei's account 第２次高市内閣の発足, dated 18 February 2026, says that after a meeting of the coalition party leaders and the announcement of the list of ministers by the Chief Cabinet Secretary (木原稔), the Prime Minister's Imperial appointment ceremony and the ministers' attestation ceremony took place at the Imperial Palace, followed by a press conference and the first cabinet meeting back at the Office; its photo captions show 高市総理 entering the Office and at the press conference.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same account states that the second Takaichi cabinet (第２次高市内閣) was launched on 18 February 2026.
